name: Wrack

bonuses.name: Power from Pain: Inured to Suffering
bonuses.text: If this Threat deals a Wound it gains +1 bonus dice to Determination Tests until the end of its next Turn.

determination: Insensible to Pain: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 52d6. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.

options.name: Mob Options
options.text: For every 5 Wracks in a Mob, one may be equipped with either of the following:

note: Print: Awareness is printed 2 with Passive 2; Determination prints "52d6".
